summary: Fixed REV-1: the explorer's rename, move and delete now update the file system and the editor's open tabs as one atomic operation. Store::repath_prefix and Store::close_prefix now build the change on a copy of the entries and save it once, restoring the previous entries if the save fails (new Store::commit, plus snapshot_entries/restore_entries). explorer_rename/move now run rename/move, then re-point the tabs, and undo the file-system rename/move if the tab update cannot be saved, so no tab is left pointing at a path that no longer exists and no half-moved item is left behind. explorer_delete now saves the closed tabs first (nothing is deleted if that save fails) and, if the Recycle Bin refuses the item, puts the tabs back so they keep pointing at the item still on disk. Added five backend tests (rename/move rollback, delete-before-removal, refused-bin restore) that prove the atomic behaviour. No other code changed.
